headlines.title: Heathrow Airport warns third runway could be delayed by four years
headlines.description: The UK's busiest airport cautions it may miss the government target of 2035 as ministers say the deadline has "always been ambitious".

headlines.title: Trump rejects Iran deal to reopen Strait of Hormuz in seven days
headlines.description: The US president says Tehran had only put forward the proposal because it is losing the war.

headlines.title: UK diesel price close to all-time high
headlines.description: The average price of a litre of diesel at the pump stands at 198.32p, according to the RAC motoring body.

headlines.title: Trump and Xi exchange warm words at state dinner but little progress on key issues
headlines.description: Despite diplomatic niceties and gifts, little was shared on substantial issues separating the leaders.

headlines.title: US rejects pleas from OpenAI, Anthropic for global AI standards
headlines.description: OpenAI's Sam Altman has called for risk evaluation standards, as have Anthropic's Dario Amodei and Hugging Face's Clement Delangue.
